description_of_food_preparation: All food items are prepared in a licensed home kitchen adhering to California cottage food laws. Ingredients are measured and mixed according to approved recipes. Products are packaged in food-grade containers and labeled with ingredients, preparation date, and storage instructions.

food_items.list_of_ingredients: Flour, sugar, eggs, buttermilk, lemons (juice and zest), blueberries, baking powder, baking soda, salt, vanilla extract, vegetable oil
